command:
set -u
old_boot='4748e9a8-6512-4453-8e32-df5922266c4f'
new_boot=$(cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id)
printf 'old_boot_id=%s\nnew_boot_id=%s\n' "$old_boot" "$new_boot"
if [ "$new_boot" != "$old_boot" ]; then printf '%s\n' 'boot_id_changed=yes'; boot_ok=0; else printf '%s\n' 'boot_id_changed=no'; boot_ok=1; fi
printf 'cronie_status='; rc-service cronie status; svc_rc=$?
rc-update show default | grep -E '(^|[[:space:]])cronie([[:space:]]|$)'; enabled_rc=$?
printf '%s\n' 'allowlist_after_restart:'
stat -c '%A %U:%G %n' /etc/cron.allow
sed -n '1,10p' /etc/cron.allow
id opsadmin
printf '* * * * * : # post-restart-access-test\n' > /tmp/post-restart-cron-test
chmod 644 /tmp/post-restart-cron-test
crontab /tmp/post-restart-cron-test >/tmp/root-post.out 2>&1; root_rc=$?
su -s /bin/sh opsadmin -c 'crontab /tmp/post-restart-cron-test' >/tmp/ops-post.out 2>&1; ops_rc=$?
su -s /bin/sh alpine -c 'crontab /tmp/post-restart-cron-test' >/tmp/alpine-post.out 2>&1; alpine_rc=$?
printf 'post_restart_access root_rc=%s opsadmin_rc=%s alpine_rc=%s\n' "$root_rc" "$ops_rc" "$alpine_rc"
printf '%s\n' 'alpine_output:'; cat /tmp/alpine-post.out
[ "$root_rc" -eq 0 ] && crontab -r >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
[ "$ops_rc" -eq 0 ] && su -s /bin/sh opsadmin -c 'crontab -r' >/dev/null 2>&1 || true
rm -f /tmp/post-restart-cron-test /tmp/root-post.out /tmp/ops-post.out /tmp/alpine-post.out
if [ "$root_rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$ops_rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$alpine_rc" -ne 0 ]; then access_ok=0; printf '%s\n' 'post_restart_access_result=pass'; else access_ok=1; printf '%s\n' 'post_restart_access_result=fail'; fi
[ "$boot_ok" -eq 0 ] && [ "$svc_rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$enabled_rc" -eq 0 ] && [ "$access_ok" -eq 0 ]
